name: Flupirtine

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in European Union, first in 2018 — for liver harm

similar.name: Cloforex
problems: Pulled from the market in Germany and Sweden, first in 1969 — for breathing problems and heart harm

summary: Flupirtine was pulled from the market in the European Union in 2018 because of liver harm [3]. In tests from a small computer model rather than studies on people, it received a high risk score of 78 for the liver and a low risk score of 33 for the heart [M]. A similar drug named Cloforex was taken off the market in Germany and Sweden in 1969 due to heart harm and breathing problems [4].
